Visual thesis: 更低重心、更厚重的夜间追猎者，横向或斜向追逐月体，轮廓和运动节奏与Sköll完全不同。

Identity anchors: 狼形；追逐月亮；冷色夜空；不同于Sköll的轮廓

Must keep: 自然狼 anatomy；月体作为远目标；不复制Sköll姿势

Must avoid: Sköll换色；装甲狼；蓝色发光魔狼；Fenrir复制；月亮已经吞噬

Composition: camera eye level; shot lateral powerful chase; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 深灰；冷银；靛蓝；灰紫; materials 毛发；夜雾；薄云；月光; mood predatory；lunar-chase；cold；mythic-natural.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010013；1003010014. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: Sköll duplicate；armor；glowing demon wolf；horns；Fenrir clone；moon swallowed；game boss；typography；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
